description: Screen an existing agent on a schedule (daily, weekly, or whenever its blueprint changes) so its score becomes a time series. Pick one of `suite_id` or `task_ids` (omit both to screen the full task catalogue). Optional spend caps pause the schedule instead of overspending. Requires a Badge API key (BADGE_API_KEY); schedules count against your plan's schedule limit.

agent_id.description: The Badge agent UUID to screen on a schedule.

budget_cap_usd_per_month.description: Pause once month-to-date spend reaches this (USD).

budget_cap_usd_per_run.description: Cap per run (the most expensive single run in a screening): pauses the schedule if any run costs more (USD).

hour_utc.description: Hour of day (UTC) to start. Default 0.

suite_id.description: Benchmark suite UUID to screen against each time.

task_ids.description: Explicit task UUIDs to screen against (instead of a suite).

weekday.description: Day of week, 0=Monday. Required for weekly, invalid otherwise.

name: schedule_suite
title: Schedule recurring screenings for an AI agent on Badge
